visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a close-up presentation of a finished salad dish in a white plate, featuring julienned carrots, sprouts, and wood ear mushrooms. A logo for @RosalinaKitchen is visible at the top. (2) The cooking process begins as a person's hands peel a large orange carrot with a silver peeler over a white plate. Thin carrot strips are then shredded using a julienne tool. (3) On a yellow cutting board, wood ear mushrooms and cucumbers are meticulously sliced into thin, uniform strips with a sharp chef's knife. The kitchen setting is bright with soft natural light. (4) Fresh scallions are chopped into small rings, and garlic cloves are crushed under a metal pitcher before being finely minced. The focus remains on the ingredients and knife movements. (5) Enoki mushrooms are removed from their packaging and rinsed in a metal strainer along with soybean sprouts. (6) A red pot of water is brought to a boil on an induction cooktop; salt is added, followed by the enoki mushrooms, wood ear strips, and soybean sprouts. (7) The blanched vegetables are drained through a colander and placed into a large stainless steel bowl to cool, tossed occasionally with chopsticks. (8) A sauce is prepared in a small bowl with red bean paste and soy sauce, then poured over the vegetables. Scallions, garlic, and white pepper are added on top. (9) Hot oil is heated in a small square pan and poured directly over the aromatics in the bowl, creating a visible sizzle. (10) Cucumber strips, vinegar, and sesame seeds are added as final ingredients, and the salad is mixed thoroughly with gloved hands. (11) A woman with short dark hair wearing a pink apron appears, eating the salad with chopsticks and expressing visible enjoyment with smiles and nods.

(31) [Subtitle]: 快速的拌一拌. (32) [Subtitle]: 最後放入小黃瓜絲. (33) [Subtitle]: 充分的拌勻... (34) [Subtitle]: 最後再來放醋 增加酸味！😋. (35) [Subtitle]: 一大匙的白芝麻. (36) [Subtitle]: 稍微的拌勻... (37) [Subtitle]: 像這樣～. audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio track starts with an upbeat acoustic pop song with a male vocal lead and a steady guitar strumming rhythm. Simultaneously, the sharp, repetitive scrapping sound of a vegetable peeler is heard. (2) Rhythmic percussive chopping sounds of a knife hitting a plastic surface dominate the mix as vegetables are sliced rapidly. The BGM maintains a consistent tempo in the background. (3) A heavy, dull thud signals the crushing of garlic, followed by high-frequency clicking sounds of fine mincing. (4) The crinkling of a plastic bag being opened is followed by the sharp metallic clank of a strainer hitting a sink. (5) Bubbling water sounds and the metallic scrape of a spoon against a pot are heard during the blanching phase. (6) A hollow pouring sound occurs as hot water is drained, followed by the soft, wet squelching of vegetables being tossed in a metal bowl. (7) Liquid pouring sounds accompany the sauce preparation. A loud, intense sizzling sound erupts as hot oil is poured over the scallions. (8) Crisp, rhythmic clicking of chopsticks against a metal bowl occurs during final mixing. The song ends on a high note with positive vocal energy.
